translations.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
translations.bsb: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.
translations.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
translations.asv: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.
